notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Hatchers! 🐣[/h2][p]I’ve got a small update for you.
After showcasing the game at Gamescom, I noticed that some of you had trouble finding your way around and discovering all the features. To make things clearer, I’ve prepared a little update for the demo with the following improvements:[/p][list][*][p]The cuckoo will now guide you through the map once, explaining the most important elements.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now reset the tutorial at any time from the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where not all Egglings were displayed when released.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing, and I’m looking forward to your feedback![/p]
